verdict.rationale: Orrick's own UK page says its venture capital team advises both companies and investors, which supports two-sided representation. Its claimed deal volume of nearly 3,000 venture financings and Top 5 PitchBook ranking imply broad exposure to market terms, but the evidence never mentions representing venture funds specifically or any market-terms reporting. Missing for 10: explicit venture fund (fund formation/LP-GP) representation, documented investor-side practice beyond one regional mention, evidence of market-terms insight such as term surveys or data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: Our venture capital team advises companies and investors at all stages of growth from incubation through to exit
Over US$157 billion in 2023-2025 through our work on nearly 3,000 venture financings
